title: C++ scaffolding: ros2_common_cpp, cpp-node-test.sh (docker), .clang-format, CI amd64 job, poe tasks
sizeReason: One deliverable: the shared ament package (8 files of its own) is only usable together with the docker test script, the CI job and the poe/CI sync tests that register it; splitting would leave a package nothing can build or test.
requirement: Tests first: tests/test_cpp_scaffolding.py and the gtests are written and seen failing before the code. (1) shared/ros2_common_cpp is an ament_cmake package (package.xml, CMakeLists.txt, include/ros2_common_cpp/config.hpp, include/ros2_common_cpp/metrics.hpp, src/config.cpp, src/metrics.cpp) with two library targets that do not link rclcpp: config (yaml-cpp; helpers require<T>, range checks ge/gt/le, forbid_unknown; validate returns std::vector<std::string> errors; load_config_or_exit reads the path from a named env var with a default path, logs every error and exits 78 on any error) and metrics (robot_node_info{node="<name>"} 1 and robot_node_start_time_seconds, counters/gauges/histograms with labels, Prometheus text exposition served on 127.0.0.1:<metrics_port>). The builder picks prometheus-cpp (libprometheus-cpp-dev) or a minimal text exporter over cpp-httplib (libcpp-httplib-dev), whichever Ubuntu 24.04 ships as apt for arm64, and records the choice and why in shared/README.md. (2) gtests test/test_config.cpp (unknown key, wrong type, out of range, missing required, exit code 78 via a death test) and test/test_metrics.cpp (exact text for robot_node_info{node="x"} 1, label escaping, histogram buckets, HTTP GET on 127.0.0.1 returns it). ament_lint_auto with ament_cmake_clang_format, ament_cmake_cppcheck and ament_cmake_xmllint; copyright lint off. (3) .clang-format at the repo root: ament style base, ColumnLimit 120. (4) scripts/cpp-node-test.sh <pkg> [--lint-only]: builds or reuses a local image from scripts/cpp-node-test.Dockerfile (FROM ros:jazzy-ros-base, native platform: arm64 on the Mac, amd64 in CI) with the rosdep keys of every in-repo C++ package preinstalled, mounts the repo read-only, copies shared/ros2_common_cpp and nodes/*_cpp into a workspace, runs rosdep install, colcon build --packages-up-to <pkg> --cmake-args -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release, colcon test --packages-select <pkg>, colcon test-result --verbose; exits non-zero on any build, test or lint failure and ends with one line 'cpp-node-test: <pkg> PASS' or 'cpp-node-test: <pkg> FAIL'; an unknown package exits 2 with the list of known ones. It generalizes scripts/probe-mppi-overlay-docker.sh (reuse its docker handling; do not copy-paste it). (5) .github/workflows/ci.yml gains a cpp job (ubuntu amd64) with a matrix of every C++ package (shared/ros2_common_cpp plus nodes/*_cpp) that runs scripts/cpp-node-test.sh; the existing uv per-node matrix skips nodes/*_cpp (no pyproject.toml). tests/test_ci_workflow.py and tests/test_node_lint_coverage.py keep both matrices in sync with the tree (a new nodes/<x>_cpp without a CI row fails). (6) Root pyproject.toml gains poe tasks test-cpp and lint-cpp that run the script for every C++ package. (7) tests/test_cpp_scaffolding.py pins: .clang-format column limit, the script's usage and PASS/FAIL line contract (static), the Dockerfile base image, the poe tasks, and that ros2_common_cpp declares the lint packages. Docs: shared/README.md (ros2_common_cpp API, metrics choice, how to add a C++ node: layout nodes/<name>_cpp with a library target without rclcpp, a component plus a standalone executable), scripts/README.md (cpp-node-test.sh), tests/README.md (every new or changed test).
value: Every later C++ node gets config validation, metrics and a test run that works on the Mac and in CI.
notes: Docker is available on the implementer Mac (docker info: Server 29.3.1, aarch64; ros:jazzy-ros-base already pulled), so the script runs here natively on arm64; CI runs the same script on amd64 (D4). Prior art: scripts/probe-mppi-overlay-docker.sh. Brief section 3, items 3-7.

title: Ansible local-source colcon build without stopping the robot, and registration of the stereo_depth_cpp and map_guard_cpp node types
sizeReason: The local build mode and the node types that use it are one deliverable: the role change is only testable through a registered node type, and the metrics, cgroup and docs contracts must move with the registration.
requirement: Tests first: tests/test_cpp_node_deploy.py written and seen failing first. (1) colcon_source_package.yml supports a local source (colcon_source.local: <repo path>, e.g. nodes/stereo_depth_cpp, plus shared/ros2_common_cpp as a chained local package): the tree is synced into /opt/ros2-ws/src/<pkg>; the stamp key is a hash of the synced tree (file contents and paths) plus the apt versions, kept as <ws>/.built-<pkg>-<key>, so an unchanged deploy builds nothing and a changed source file changes the key. (2) The build runs in the existing low-priority scope (systemd-run --scope CPUWeight=20 IOWeight=10, nice -n 19, ionice -c 3, --parallel-workers 1, -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF, MAKEFLAGS=-j2). (3) A local-source build never includes stop_for_build.yml; only the node's own unit restarts after a build (D4). Pinned-commit upstream builds (rf2o, camera_ros, MPPI) keep their current behaviour. (4) ansible/group_vars/client.yml defines node types stereo_depth_cpp (node_src_dir "", colcon local source, node_launch_command 'ros2 run stereo_depth_cpp stereo_depth_node', background cgroup tier exactly like stereo_depth, METRICS port 19113, env STEREO_DEPTH_CONFIG=/etc/ros2/stereo_depth_cpp/config.yaml, apt build deps) and map_guard_cpp (same tier and memory class as map_guard, port 19110, env MAP_GUARD_CONFIG=/etc/ros2/map_guard_cpp/config.yaml), and ros2_nodes entries for both with present: false and enabled: false and a config block identical to the Python node's (the cut-over is T8). (5) ansible/playbooks/deploy_nodes_client.yml deploys both by name with tags [<name>, build, config], after their Python counterparts. (6) tests/test_node_metrics_wiring.py lists both ports; a port may be shared only by a <name>/<name>_cpp pair, and the test asserts such a pair is never both enabled. tests/test_unit_cgroups.py puts stereo_depth_cpp in the background tier types. (7) tests/test_cpp_node_deploy.py asserts: the stamp changes when a source file changes and not otherwise (render the key expression), local builds do not include stop_for_build, the low-priority scope flags, both node types and entries as above. Docs: ansible/README.md (local-source build, stamp, no stop-all, the two node types), nodes/README.md (rows for both _cpp nodes marked side-by-side, Python node is the rollback), .claude/skills/ansible-deploy/SKILL.md node table rows, tests/README.md.
value: C++ nodes deploy through the normal script without stopping the robot, and unchanged deploys build nothing.
notes: Brief section 3 item 2. Depends on T6 only because both edit ansible/group_vars/client.yml (uvc_camera apt package); T6 is small and independent.
verify: uv run pytest tests/test_cpp_node_deploy.py tests/test_node_metrics_wiring.py tests/test_unit_cgroups.py tests/test_ansible_deploy_speed.py -q && uv run poe lint && uv run poe test-ansible

title: stereo_depth_cpp: rclcpp port of stereo_depth with parity fixtures and a CPU bench
sizeReason: One node package: library sources, node, config, gtests, fixtures, fixture generator, bench and README all live under nodes/stereo_depth_cpp and only work together.
requirement: Tests first: each gtest is written and seen failing before its source. (1) nodes/stereo_depth_cpp is an ament_cmake package using ros2_common_cpp: a library without rclcpp (src/depth.cpp: matcher factory with the Python node's SGBM parameters, disparity to depth mm; src/calibration.cpp: loads the same stereo.yaml and left/right YAMLs, builds rectification maps, re-checks the calibration signature; src/config.cpp: every DepthConfig field and rejection of nodes/stereo_depth/stereo_depth/config.py, extra keys forbidden, exit 78) and src/stereo_depth_node.cpp registered as an rclcpp_components component plus a standalone stereo_depth_node executable. (2) Same contract as the Python node: message_filters ApproximateTime pair with sync_slop_s, rate cap with RATE_JITTER_FRACTION, the same drop reasons, the same input and output topics and QoS, 16UC1 depth in mm with 0 = invalid. (3) No placeholder data: nothing is published without a valid calibration or without a pair; size mismatch and excessive skew are dropped and counted. (4) Same metric names and labels: stereo_depth_frames_published_total, stereo_depth_frames_dropped_total{reason}, the matcher seconds histogram, pair skew, calibration loaded, plus robot_node_info{node}. (5) Parity: test/gen_fixtures.py runs the Python functions (nodes/stereo_depth, its uv env) on the shifted synthetic pair from nodes/stereo_depth/tests and writes test/fixtures/*; it has a --check mode that fails when committed fixtures are stale. gtests assert depth mm within 1 mm on valid pixels and an identical invalid mask. (6) gtests cover config (every rejection), depth conversion, calibration load and invalid cases, rate cap, skew drop and size mismatch. (7) scripts/bench_compare.py (config file scripts/bench_compare.yaml) runs the Python and C++ depth paths on the same input for N pairs and prints CPU seconds per pair for each. The Python calibrate and bench tools stay in nodes/stereo_depth. No Ansible change in this task (T2 registers, T8 cuts over). Docs: nodes/stereo_depth_cpp/README.md (contract, config, metrics, parity, bench, how to test with scripts/cpp-node-test.sh, rollback to the Python node).
value: Stereo depth without the rclpy per-image cost, so it fits on the saturated client.
notes: Standalone process in the background tier (D3). The right camera (cam1) is not probing; verification is by tests and the bench, on the robot once both cameras stream.

title: web_ui lazy serialization and CompressedImage JPEG pass-through
requirement: Tests first in nodes/web_ui/tests/test_lazy_serialization.py, seen failing first. (1) Subscription callbacks only store the raw latest message per topic and mark it dirty; serialization happens in flush_dirty() only, only for topics a connected client subscribes to, and at most once per flush (N messages between flushes give one serialization). (2) With no client connected nothing is serialized. (3) CompressedImage whose format is JPEG is passed through without decode and re-encode (byte equality between the ROS message data and the payload the client receives); the downscaled second JPEG is produced only when a connected client's head tab needs color_small. (4) The WS envelope contract is unchanged: the existing web_ui tests stay green. No new placeholder data. Docs: nodes/web_ui/README.md (serialization model, pass-through).
value: web_ui stops spending 0.3-0.45 core serializing frames nobody is looking at.
notes: Brief section 2 (web_ui), bridge.py:418-445, msg_serializer.py:184-219. web_ui stays Python (user rule).

title: uvc_camera MJPEG pass-through with lossless 180 rotation
requirement: Tests first in nodes/bridges/uvc_camera/tests/test_mjpeg.py, seen failing first. (1) A config field capture_format ('mjpeg' default, 'raw') in config.py; with mjpeg the device is opened with the MJPG fourcc and CAP_PROP_CONVERT_RGB off, and the camera's JPEG bytes are published on <topic>/compressed without a CPU re-encode. (2) rotate_deg 180 (the gripper camera's setting) is applied losslessly on the JPEG (libjpeg-turbo transform via PyTurboJPEG, with trim), never by decode and re-encode; 90/270 also use the lossless transform. (3) The raw Image topic is decoded and published only while it has subscribers. (4) If the device does not deliver MJPEG (fourcc readback), the node logs it once and uses the current raw path; it never publishes placeholder frames. (5) camera_encode_seconds keeps its meaning (time to produce the published JPEG). (6) The uvc_camera node type in ansible/group_vars/client.yml gains the apt package libturbojpeg0 (only that change in group_vars); the Python dependency goes in pyproject.toml and uv.lock. Existing uvc_camera tests stay green. Docs: nodes/bridges/uvc_camera/README.md.
value: The gripper camera stops spending about 0.1 core on JPEG encoding.
notes: client.yml sets UVC_ROTATE_DEG=180 for gripper_uvc_camera, so pass-through without lossless rotation would never apply.

title: mcp_server (Python): latest-only raw cache for joint states and odom, decoded lazily
